hero.headline: Track your baby's day, together
hero.sub: Sleep, feeds, diapers and medicines in one place, made by parents of a newborn. Works offline, shares with your co-parent.

story.title: Why we made Lotties
story.one: When our first baby arrived, we kept asking each other: what time was the last feed? Has the baby slept today? Did we give the medicine? After a sleepless night, memory fails. We wanted a simple place to write it down, where both of us could see the same thing.
story.two: We could not find the app we wanted, so we built our own. It was born from our routine as parents. If it helps other parents going through the same, it was worth it.
story.three: One important thing: Lotties does not tell you what to do. It only looks at what you logged yourself and shows what usually happens, as likely answers. Over time, and if more families choose to take part, anonymously, those statistics could get better.
story.four: Lotties is not a medical app, it is a baby routine app. It does not diagnose, does not replace your pediatrician and is not responsible for health decisions. When in doubt, talk to whoever looks after your baby's health.

log.title: Log in a few taps
log.body: Sleep, breast and bottle feeds, diapers, medicines, baths and fussy spells. Start a timer, tap a tile, undo a slip. Works offline and syncs when you are back online.

today.title: See the day and what comes next
today.body: A timeline of the day, totals for sleep, feeds and diapers, and charts of the week. The home screen shows what is likely next: nap, feed or diaper change.

share.title: Care together
share.body: Invite a partner, grandparent or nanny with a link. Choose what each person can do, see who logged what, and share selected sections with your pediatrician.

predict.title: Gentle predictions
predict.body: See the next nap window with a plain explanation of how it was worked out. Estimates from your logged history, not medical advice.

health.title: Growth, vaccines and medicines
health.body: Weight and height on growth charts, the Brazilian vaccination schedule, appointments, and medicines with safe intervals. The doctor's prescription is always the source.

data.title: Free, private, yours
data.body: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0) and can be self-hosted. No ads, no tracking. Import from Napper and export a backup any time.

one.title: Sign in
one.body: Create an account or sign in. It takes a minute.

two.title: Add your baby
two.body: Log sleep, feeds, diapers and medicines as they happen.

three.title: Invite your co-parent
three.body: Share a link. You both see the same day.

openSource.title: Built on open source
openSource.body: Lotties stands on the work of the open-source community and on public health data. Thank you to every author and maintainer.
openSource.license: Lotties itself is free software under the AGPL-3.0.
openSource.notMedical: Lotties is not a medical device.

important.title: Not a medical device
important.body: Estimates come from your logged history and are not medical advice. Lotties helps you keep a record and spot patterns; it does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
important.care: For any health concern, or before giving or changing a medicine, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
